Title: Permission Guard — Rep With Global Role but No Org Membership Is ADMITTED to My Customers (VCST-5494)
Section: Storefront > Sales Rep > Gating
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
SPLIT + ROOT-CAUSE CONFIRMED (TLC Phase-2 sync, 2026-07-17 — was "Empty State — Rep With Zero Served Customers", asserted the empty-customers TABLE renders). SUPERSEDED BY VCST-5494 (re-based 2026-09-04). The 2026-07-17 root cause below no longer holds: myCustomersRoute now carries meta requiresOrganization:false specifically so a rep holding sales-rep:access as a GLOBAL role with ZERO org memberships CLEARS the generic /company org-membership gate. The guard keys on permission only (isSalesRepsEnabled() && checkPermissions(SALES_REP_ACCESS_PERMISSION)) — org-membership COUNT is irrelevant to admission. SR_REP_NOCUSTOMERS is therefore ADMITTED to /company/my-customers and sees the ordinary zero-customers empty state. What this case now guards is the admission itself; SR-FE-054 guards that the admitted surface leaks no data. This was scenario (a) of the split; scenario (b) — a permissioned rep WITH org context serving zero customers, showing the actual empty TABLE — was proposed as SR-FE-030 but has since been DEPRECATED (TLC-2026-07-17-1603): a sales-rep org membership IS the served-customer relationship, so that state is architecturally unreachable and its gap fixture (SR_REP_NOCUSTOMERS_ORGCTX) is permanently retired.
RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-04 (TCA-2026-09-04, suite-089 triangulation): signed in as SR_REP_NOCUSTOMERS, navigating to {{FRONT_URL}}/company/my-customers STAYS at /company/my-customers — no redirect — with the Sales Rep hub rail section visible and the ordinary "No customers found" empty state, 0 console errors, all /graphql 200.
